title: Đề thi thử TOEIC #1 (Đề rút gọn 20 câu)
description: Đề thi thử rút gọn gồm 20 câu hỏi (10 Listening + 10 Reading) chuẩn hóa theo định dạng TOEIC.

items.audio: The man is reviewing documents at his desk.
items.transcript: The man is reviewing documents at his desk.
options: A man is leaving the office.
items.explanation: "Reviewing documents at his desk" = Đang xem xét tài liệu tại bàn.

items.audio: Has the new software been installed yet?
items.transcript: Has the new software been installed yet?
options: No, the IT department is still working on it.
items.explanation: "Has...been installed" → câu trả lời phù hợp: "No, the IT department is still working on it."

items.audio: Could you please send me the meeting minutes?
items.transcript: Could you please send me the meeting minutes?
options: Sure, I'll email them to you right away.
items.explanation: "Could you..." là yêu cầu → "Sure, I'll email them..." là trả lời phù hợp.

items.audio: Where should I leave these signed contracts?
items.transcript: Where should I leave these signed contracts?
items.explanation: "Where" hỏi nơi chốn → "On Ms. Davis's desk, please."

items.audio: Why didn't you attend the marketing workshop yesterday?
items.transcript: Why didn't you attend the marketing workshop yesterday?
options: I had an urgent client call.
items.explanation: "Why" hỏi lý do → "I had an urgent client call."

items.audio: Could you check if the conference projector is working?
items.transcript: Could you check if the conference projector is working?
options: Sure, I'll test it right now.
items.explanation: "Could you check..." yêu cầu lịch sự → "Sure, I'll test it right now."

items.audio: Attention all passengers on train 104 to Chicago. Due to maintenance work on the main track, our departure will be delayed by 30 minutes. We expect to begin boarding at platform 4 at 10:15 AM. Complimentary coffee and bottled water are available at the customer lounge near ticket counter B.
items.transcript: Attention all passengers on train 104 to Chicago. Due to maintenance work on the main track, our departure will be delayed by 30 minutes. We expect to begin boarding at platform 4 at 10:15 AM. Complimentary coffee and bottled water are available at the customer lounge near ticket counter B.
items.explanation: Thông báo hoãn tàu do bảo trì đường ray, khởi hành lúc 10:15 AM, nước uống miễn phí tại lounge cạnh quầy vé B.

questions.q: What is the reason for the delay?
questions.explanation: "Due to maintenance work on the main track".

questions.q: What is provided for free at the customer lounge?
questions.explanation: "Complimentary coffee and bottled water are available".

items.q: The board of directors _____ the proposal unanimously at yesterday's meeting.
items.explanation: Cần động từ quá khứ đơn (yesterday's meeting). "approved" là V2/ed.

items.q: Employees are required to wear _____ at all times in the laboratory.
items.explanation: Sau "wear" cần danh từ. "protection" = sự bảo vệ (protective equipment).

items.q: The factory, _____ was built in 2015, has been expanded twice since then.
items.explanation: "which" thay thế cho "the factory" (vật) trong mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định.

items.q: If the supplier _____ the materials on time, we would have met the deadline.
items.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: If + had V3, would have V3. "had delivered" là đáp án đúng.

items.q: The seminar has been _____ until next Wednesday due to the speaker's illness.
items.explanation: "postponed until" = hoãn lại đến. "Canceled" không đi với "until" trong ngữ cảnh này.

items.q: The newly hired accountant has shown remarkable _____ in financial forecasting.
items.explanation: Sau tính từ "remarkable" cần một danh từ: "competence" (năng lực).

items.q: Mr. Harrison _____ the contract only after his legal advisor reviewed each clause.
items.explanation: Mệnh đề quá khứ ("reviewed") cần động từ quá khứ đơn: "signed".

items.passage:
NOTICE

To: All Department Heads
From: Office of the CEO
Date: June 1

Starting July 1, all purchase orders above $5,000 must be approved by the Finance Director before processing. This policy applies to all departments without exception. Department heads are responsible for communicating this change to their teams.

For questions, contact the Finance Department at ext. 3200.
items.explanation: Thông báo về quy trình phê duyệt đơn mua hàng trên $5,000 phải được Finance Director duyệt. Department heads chịu trách nhiệm thông báo cho nhóm.

options: A new approval process for purchases
questions.explanation: Nội dung là quy trình phê duyệt mua sắm mới ("approval process for purchases").

questions.q: What amount requires Finance Director approval?
questions.explanation: "all purchase orders above $5,000 must be approved by the Finance Director".

questions.q: Who must inform their teams about this change?
questions.explanation: "Department heads are responsible for communicating this change to their teams".
